contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Split text on separator retaining empty fields. Parse each field by removing all ECMAScript whitespace and using a first decimal comma only when no dot exists. Accept signed plain decimal only, not exponents or suffixes. Use fallback for each invalid field; do not discard any field.
contract.domain: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Separator is nonempty. Each field has at most 20 characters; accepted values are finite between -1000 and 1000. Fallback is finite between -1000 and 1000.

inputRoles.fallback: number used separately for each invalid field

contract.outputRole: one parsed number per field, retaining positions
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
